name: Raja Rammohun Roy
role: Early reformer and key intellectual of the Bengal Renaissance
contribution: He argued for social and religious reform and advanced new intellectual currents that shaped modern public debate in Bengal.
context: In early colonial Bengal, he worked across language, law, and public discourse at a formative historical moment.
impact: He is widely regarded as one of the foundational architects of modern reformist thought in Bengal.
highlight: A foundational bridge between tradition and modern reform in Bengal.
seoTitle: Raja Rammohun Roy: Founder of Bengal’s Reformist Public Sphere
seoDescription: Learn about Raja Rammohun Roy’s social and religious reform, public writing, and role in the intellectual beginnings of the Bengal Renaissance.
shortAnswer: Raja Rammohun Roy was an early Bengal reformer whose work connected religious debate, law, education, and modern public life.
